name: Iwato San
source:
San is the captain of the Track Team; she is always calm and is the fastest runner in the team. San calls [url=/c98390]Mitsuru[/url] "Mi-kun" and [url=/c98388]Mutsumi[/url] "Mu-chan".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
